item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00130","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C04","C19"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.75,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 plausibly supplied a material template for replying to a private organization's endorsement of an Administration foreign-policy position: acknowledge the letter, express appreciation for the organization's continuing support, and emphasize the value of communicating that support publicly. C04 has similar gratitude for a message supporting the President's position, while C19 shares the Berlin subject but not the child's response-to-organizational-support structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Thank you very much for your letter of yesterday. For a long time I have been keenly aware and appreciative of the firm stand taken by the AFL-CIO in support of the government's refusal","parent_excerpt":"I want to express my appreciation for your letter of November twentieth on behalf of the United States Council of the International Chamber of Commerce. I am heartened to know that the Council continues its support of the Administration's program","explanation":"Both open by acknowledging a letter from a major private organization and praising its continuing support for an Administration position involving international affairs."},{"child_excerpt":"Your present letter should convince everyone, including the Soviets","parent_excerpt":"the United States Council will continue its efforts to explain to the public the compelling reasons for our membership in the organization","explanation":"Both treat the supporting organization's letter or advocacy as useful public persuasion beyond the immediate correspondence."},{"child_excerpt":"I am grateful for your letter because even though I have had no doubt ... of AFL-CIO solidarity in this matter, I salute your entire membership for reaffirming this solidarity before the entire world.","parent_excerpt":"I am especially interested in the last sentence of your letter which gives assurance that the United States Council will continue its efforts","explanation":"The child parallels C12's emphasis on reassurance that an organization's support will continue and be publicly expressed."}]}
